description: Checkpoints used by SORD (sord/priors.py via configs/sord/*.yaml) and, as optional entries, by the paper's baselines. 'path' is relative to CHECKPOINT_ROOT; a directory entry lists its files relative to that directory. The authors' own weights are distributed as zip archives in ONE shared Google Drive folder: set 'gdrive.folder_url' below to that folder's share link (see CHECKPOINT_UPLOAD_GUIDE.md); each such checkpoint names its archive in 'gdrive_archive'.

gdrive.note: One shared folder (Anyone with the link: Viewer) holding the sord_*.zip archives built by scripts/package_checkpoints.py (sord_thirdparty_*.zip: copies of third-party weights, subject to their providers' terms). Optional: 'archives' {zip name: file share link} overrides the folder for single archives.
